title: How to animate sprites locally for FREE (with only one reference image)
author: CommercialOpening599
selftext: Hey guys! I see often new tools to generate animations from a single sprite being posted here so I made video about how you can make them locally for free. I explain my process step by step in the video but if anyone has any questions let me know!

comments.author: Independent-Hat-3601
comments.body: Cant you just give the guide as written version or point me at the models rather than watching the video?

replies.body:
People here complain about comercial products being posted instead of showing the workflow behind the tools and this fellow created a video so you can make it for free, locally or maybe you can use it to integrate it in your game or improve it.

Just watch the video or ask Gemini to summarize it and maybe drop here the answer for everyone to see it.

replies.body: Except he locked the workflows behind a patreon paywall.

replies.author: CommercialOpening599
replies.body: Hello! The workflow I showcase as demonstration in my video is one I made for my specific use case. The comment you linked is from the author of [this LoRa](https://civitai.com/models/2085866/wan22-pixel-style-attack-sprite-animation-lora) which I do NOT use NOR sell as mine!

replies.author: HLCYSWAP
replies.body: no he didnt make a workflow, the video shows the end result. if you want the workflow you have to pay $5 for his patreon

replies.author: CommercialOpening599
replies.body:
Hello! The workflow I showcase in my video was one I made and use for my specific use case. The idea of the video was to showcase how ComfyUI can be used to generate animated sprites for people who already know their ways around ComfyUI or for people not so familiar with the tool to make their own workflows using the same nodes I use! 

I have realized now that I should have gone more in depth in the explanation part. I will take it into consideration for future videos!

comments.author: HLCYSWAP
comments.body: nothing about this workflow works: it produces 4 second long 0 motion videos, the 'script' he sells doesnt work locally, when i rewrote it to work locally it doesnt actually install the 10+ custom\_nodes needed, it only downloads 2 WAN models, after doing all that, it still doesnt work. dont get scammed.

replies.author: CommercialOpening599
replies.body:
Hey man! I see you are still having issues. I have updated both the workflow and script and they should now work plug and play out of the box. You can get them from patreon (and still have access to it even if you canceled subscription!). I recommend you try again in a brand new environment to see if it now works for you.

If you still have issues after this, you can write me a direct message and we can troubleshoot together!

comments.author: imnotabot303
comments.body:
This is basically just a Patreon ad.

It's one thing selling an automation script for setup but you don't even include the workflows for free.

So none of this is "free" it's all locked behind your Patreon paywall.

replies.author: CommercialOpening599
replies.body: Hello! ComfyUI is an open source free tool that everyone can download for free. As I explain in the video, they have many template workflows that you can use to generate videos and if you use the same nodes I do, which are all free (and explained in the video) you basically get the same results!

replies.body: Hello! Most of the LoRa's I use are either personal or commissioned. I believe the only one I use listed on CivitAI is [this one](https://civitai.com/models/2264812/wan-22-padl00p) to make more seamless loops but I am working on an SVI workflow for perfect loops with no degradations and consistency
